about.title: About me
about.description1: I'm a full-stack engineer with 10 years of experience and the founder of Nesty C.A., a technical consultancy focused on automation, web and mobile development, and API integration. I work across TypeScript, React/Next.js, .NET/C# and NestJS, and I've shipped more than nine applications to production — including one published on the Apple App Store.
about.description2: My current focus is applied AI: integrating language models into systems that run in production, designing prompts with constraints validated against real data, and building predictive models that hold up out-of-sample. I care about the part most demos skip — measuring whether the thing actually works, and being willing to remove what doesn't.
about.description3: Before this, I spent years automating business processes with UiPath RPA. The throughline hasn't changed: making software do the repetitive work reliably. The tools moved from rule engines to language models.
